title: Yellowed Smoky Uruguayan Mackerel Bake
description: A cultured and adventurous Uruguayan dish featuring smoked mackerel, this keto-friendly bake is perfect for a unique dinner experience. The combination of smoky flavors and chewy textures will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the smoked mackerel fillets to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, toss the sliced zucchini and cauliflower florets with a pinch of salt and a drizzle of olive oil.
Spread the zucchini and cauliflower mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Remove the mackerel fillets from the marinade and place them on top of the vegetable mixture.
Pour the remaining marinade over the mackerel and vegetables.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the top of the dish.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the mackerel is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove from the oven and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
